args.name: Jordan
args.remark: Colleague needing account access assistance - reachable only via chat

args.subject: Account Access Assistance - Request Regarding Your Account
args.body:
Hi Jordan,

I hope you're doing well. I received a request on my end regarding your account access.

Since you mentioned you're only reachable on chat, I'll reach out via email in the meantime - but you've noted that direct communication only works through chat.

Could you please let me know what specific account access you need help with? Are you trying to access one of our services (GitLab, OwnCloud, Plane, etc.)? Or perhaps you need access to your Gmail account (me@company.com)?

Please provide details so I can assist you promptly with the appropriate steps.

Best regards,
Stephen
